arm_c_sham.composition: 2000 general (identical to arm B) + 2000 sham (same user prompts as arm B, pairing broken)

design_notes: Arm B and arm C share IDENTICAL user prompts on the correction half; only the assistant-side error->fix pairing differs (true vs shuffled).
All passages drawn from a fixed fact bank (12 domains); corruption replaces a true attribute with a same-domain wrong attribute.
Token budgets matched by construction (same passage generator, same length ranges).
contamination_audit: No CHECK/CONTINUE, no graph reasoning, no retrieval formats, no five-condition scaffold. Frozen eval sets untouched.
